question: Does JaxFNE 0.5.8 reproduce the sealed SCI-EI-REGIME-1 and SCI-EI-INTERACTION-1 receipts and verdicts?
authority: owner 2026-10-29: 'Full redo' (always the latest JaxFNE, redo everything), then 'ok proceed; we gotta do so many simulations and make real progress' after the option 'Replay EI'. Authorized in manifests/todo.json as SCI-EI-REPLAY-058
principal_delta: engine only: JaxFNE 0.5.8 in place of the sealed engine. No parameter, seed, duration, tonic, weight, repair, rule or tolerance changes

engine.interpreter: any Python with jaxfne 0.5.8 and jax 0.10.2; each run log prints both versions before the run

frozen.driver_note: the regime driver that ran (e6b804e) differs from the one sealed here by the migration commit 5a01add: declare_retinal_interface replaces a bare add_column. Measured graph-neutral under JaxFNE 0.4.25 (2224 neurons, 1294396 edges before and 246844 after enforce, identical weight bytes). This replay checks the construction again: the regime receipt's edges_total must read 246844

runs.stage: visualization only, not used for rates
visualization only, not used for rates; keeps the final 1000 ms of 13000 ms

amendments.change: V1-PROBE and V2-PROBE run through results/whole_system_ei_interaction_spec.json, the spec SCI-EI-INTERACTION-1 used for its own probes. The regime spec has no top-level kernel block; the oscillator probe raised KeyError 'kernel' before any reading. The interaction spec inherits the same construction, and its baseline cell is the regime intact arm.
amendments.reason: the probe failed before it produced a reading; the failure is recorded in this amendment, not hidden

amendments.change: every run in runs[] executes as python scripts/ei_replay_058_run.py <driver> <the same arguments>. The wrapper passes noise_scale = 0.2236068 to each compile_step_fn call (kernel baseline, dt 0.1 ms), so the realized native-noise coefficient is 0.5 as in the sealed runs, not the 1.1180 the 0.5.8 default realizes (emitters.py _noise_coef, DT_REF_MS = 0.5). The driver files are unchanged; the wrapper refuses any other dt, kernel or driver-supplied noise_scale.
amendments.reason: attempt 1 (0.5.8 default noise, no pin) ran to completion and classified ENGINE_SHIFT, but the default noise coefficient changed as well as the engine, so that shift is not an engine-only effect and cannot be attributed to the engine. Attempt 1 is kept unchanged as results/ei_replay_058_attempt1_unpinned and is not the replay of record. The pin is fixed here, before any pinned run, and was not chosen from any pinned reading

amendments.change: scripts/ei_replay_058_compare.py counts a text leaf as a difference unless its sealed and replay values are both .npz artifact paths. The two such leaves per receipt (y_FEF_L6_E/artifact and series_storage/where) are listed as location_diffs and are not counted. classification is the label under this rule; classification_as_run is the label the rule before this amendment gave (ENGINE_SHIFT)
amendments.reason: the pinned replay matches the sealed numbers exactly: numeric diffs 0 and max abs diff 0 in all five receipts, and every verdict label equal. The only differences are artifact location strings, which the earlier rule read as an engine difference. This lineage asks whether the engine reproduces the sealed numbers and verdicts, and a file location is not evidence about that. Owner decision (accept) on 2026-10-30, taken after the comparison output was read. The numeric tolerance (1e-9) and every label rule are unchanged; the as-run label stays in comparison.json

order: V0 render and V1 render, both viewed, then REGIME, BASELINE, W_ONLY, A_ONLY, BOTH, one process at a time; then scripts/ei_replay_058_compare.py; then V2 render; then V3 atlas

visualization_contract.rule: V0 and V1 are rendered and viewed before any run. V2 reuses V1's ordering and window. V3 is built after the runs

comparison.rule: every leaf of each sealed receipt is compared with its replay counterpart. Receipts store rates to 4 decimals, so a shift below 5e-5 Hz cannot appear in this check; that limit is stated with the result

classification.REPRODUCED: no leaf differs and every label equal
classification.ENGINE_SHIFT: a leaf differs and every label equal
classification.VERDICT_CHANGED: a regime or interaction label differs, or the recomputed interaction label differs from the sealed one

viability_rule: sealed rule: PV in [12, 25], VIP in [8, 15], SST in [6, 12] and E < PV, on rates_full_resolution; interaction label from the four cells per the sealed verdict_mapping
acceptance: all five arms complete with execution, collapse and runaway passing; comparison.json written; the classification is stated with each difference listed; the lineage record names every receipt and the four contract artifacts
stop_condition: STOP after the comparison, the V2 render and the V3 atlas. A run-health trip is EXECUTION_FAIL and is reported, not rerun with changed settings. No reading is seen and then used to change a parameter, rule or tolerance
